#9 Updated “generating set” to “extremal generating set” in the statement of the Giraud theorem for Grothendieck quasitoposes. That more closely matches the terminology used on the referenced page and in the rest of nLab, whereas Johnstone’s book uses “generator” to mean what nLab calls “extremal generating set” or “extremal separator”. In fact, I believe the category of quasitopological spaces is an example of a quasitopos which is locally small and cocomplete and has a generator object (1), but which does not have an extremal generating set.

Daniel Schepler
